items.title: 23.3.2 Aldehydes aur ketones ke tests (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the tests for aldehydes and ketones (PDF 106-107).

blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones carboxylic acids mein oxidise hote hain, lekin aldehydes aasani se jab ke ketones mushkil se, kyunke C-C bond torna parta hai. Ketones sirf taqatwar oxidising agents se oxidise hote hain, jab ke aldehydes kamzor aur taqatwar dono se. Is liye narm oxidising agents dono ko alag pehchante hain.

items: Tollens' test: Tollens' reagent (ammoniacal silver nitrate) mein aabi alkaline mehlool mein silver ions hote hain: AgNO3 + 3NH4OH -> [Ag(NH3)2]OH + NH4NO3 + 2H2O. Aldehyde ke saath halka garam karne par silver ions silver dhaat mein reduce ho kar tube ki deewar par chandi ka aaina banate hain. Glucose (aldehydic shakar) ke halke mehlool se is tarah aaine banaye gaye hain. Ketones yeh test nahi dete.

Fehling's test: Fehling's solution aabi alkali mein Cu2+ ions ka chamakdar neela mehlool hai, tartaric acid ke namak ke saath complex. Aldehyde ke saath garam karne par Cu2+, Cu+ mein reduce hota, jo alkaline mehlool mein copper(I) oxide ka eent jaisa surkh precipitate banata hai: RCHO + 2Cu(OH)2 + NaOH -> RCOONa + Cu2O + 3H2O. Ketones yeh test nahi dete.

Iodoform test: aldehydes aur ketones alpha position par aasani se halogenate hote hain. Aldehydes mein sirf ethanal aur ketones mein sirf methyl ketones mein CH3CO- (acetyl) group hota hai. Yeh sodium hydroxide mein iodine se react kar ke triiodomethane (iodoform), peela qalmi thos, banate hain, is liye peela precipitate CH3CO- group dikhata hai: CH3CHO + 3I2 + 4NaOH -> CHI3 + HCOONa + 3NaI + 3H2O; CH3COCH3 + 3I2 + 4NaOH -> CHI3 + CH3COONa + 3NaI + 3H2O.

blocks.alt: Gol pende wala flask jis ki andar ki deewar par chamakdar chandi ka aaina (silver mirror) jam gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 23.3: Sirf aldehydes Tollens' test musbat dete hain (kitab ki Figure 23.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Do test tubes: baen wali mein chamakdar neela Fehling's solution; teer ('aldehyde, warm') ke baad daen wali ke pende mein eent jaisa surkh Cu2O precipitate.
blocks.caption: Fehling's test: aldehyde ke saath garam karne par neela mehlool eent jaisa surkh Cu2O deta hai (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein is ki tasveer nahi).

blocks.alt: Halke peele maaye wala gol flask, jis ke pende mein peela iodoform baith gaya hai.
blocks.caption: CH3CO group wale aldehydes aur ketones, aur CH3-CH(OH) group wale alcohols, iodoform test dete hain; is reaction mein peela iodoform banta hai (kitab ke PDF safha 107 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen tests ke nateeje: Tollens' mein flask ki deewar par chandi ka aaina, Fehling's mein neele mehlool se eent jaisa surkh Cu2O, aur iodoform mein peela CHI3 precipitate. Fehling's ki tasveer kitab mein nahi; woh khaaka hamara apna hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke dabbe mein 'iodoform id formed' chhapa hai; durust 'iodoform is formed' (iodoform banta hai) hai.

Ethanol bhi iodoform test deta hai, jab ke methanol nahi. Ethanol mein CH3CH(OH)- group hai: iodine pehle use ethanal, CH3CHO, mein oxidise karti hai, jis mein CH3CO- group hai: CH3CH2OH + 4I2 + 6NaOH -> CHI3 + HCOONa + 5NaI + 5H2O. Aam taur par CH3CH(OH)- group wale alcohols yeh test dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab acetone ke iodoform reaction ka product HCOONa likhti hai. Propanone, CH3COCH3, ke liye banne wala namak sodium ethanoate, CH3COONa, hai; sodium methanoate, HCOONa, ethanal se banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Compound A, C3H6O, NaBH4 se B, C3H8O, mein reduce hota hai. Dono I2/NaOH ke saath peela precipitate dete hain. A aur B pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: A propanone, CH3COCH3 (methyl ketone), hai; B propan-2-ol, CH3CH(OH)CH3 (is mein CH3CH(OH)- group hai), hai.

blocks.prompt: Methanol iodoform test kyun nahi deta jab ke ethanol deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Methanol mein CH3CH(OH)- group nahi (yeh methanal mein oxidise hota, jis mein CH3CO- group nahi); ethanol ethanal, CH3CHO, mein oxidise hota jis mein yeh group hai.

blocks.prompt: Har jore ko alag karne ka mukhtalif test batayein: (i) CH3CH2CHO aur CH3COCH3; (ii) CH3CH2COCH2CH3 aur CH3CH2CH2COCH3; (iii) CH2=CH-CH2-OH aur CH3CH2CHO.
blocks.explanation: (i) Tollens' (ya Fehling's): propanal chandi ka aaina deta, propanone nahi. (ii) Iodoform: pentan-2-one (methyl ketone) peela precipitate deta, pentan-3-one nahi. (iii) 2,4-DNPH: propanal narangi precipitate deta, prop-2-en-1-ol (alcohol) nahi.

items: Aldehydes aasani se oxidise; ketones nahi.
Tollens': chandi ka aaina; Fehling's: eent jaisa surkh Cu2O (sirf aldehydes).
Iodoform (I2/NaOH): CH3CO- ya CH3CH(OH)- groups ke saath peela CHI3.
